description: This file defines the Aws\Efs\EfsClient class which extends Aws\AwsClient to interact with Amazon Elastic File System (EFS). It includes method annotations for various EFS operations, specifying both synchronous and asynchronous versions.

classes.name: EfsClient
classes.description: A client class used to perform operations on Amazon EFS via AWS SDK.

methods.name: createAccessPoint
methods.description: Creates an access point in Amazon EFS.

methods.name: createAccessPointAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates an access point in Amazon EFS.

methods.name: createFileSystem
methods.description: Creates a new EFS file system.

methods.name: createFileSystemAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new EFS file system.

methods.name: createMountTarget
methods.description: Creates a mount target for an EFS file system.

methods.name: createMountTargetAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a mount target for an EFS file system.

methods.name: createReplicationConfigurationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates replication configuration for EFS.

methods.name: createTags
methods.description: Adds tags to an EFS resource.

methods.name: createTagsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously adds tags to an EFS resource.

methods.name: deleteAccessPoint
methods.description: Deletes an access point in EFS.

methods.name: deleteAccessPointAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes an access point in EFS.

methods.name: deleteFileSystemAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes an EFS file system.

methods.name: deleteFileSystemPolicy
methods.description: Deletes the policy associated with an EFS file system.

methods.name: deleteFileSystemPolicyAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes the policy of an EFS file system.

methods.name: deleteTags
methods.description: Removes tags from an EFS resource.

methods.name: deleteTagsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from an EFS resource.

methods.name: describeAccountPreferences
methods.description: Describes account preferences related to EFS.

methods.name: describeFileSystemPolicyAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously describes the file system policy.

methods.name: describeFileSystems
methods.description: Describes one or more EFS file systems.

methods.name: describeMountTargetSecurityGroups
methods.description: Describes security groups for a mount target.

methods.name: describeMountTargetSecurityGroupsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously describes mount target security groups.

methods.name: describeTags
methods.description: Describes tags for an EFS resource.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tags for a resource.

methods.name: modifyMountTargetSecurityGroups
methods.description: Modifies the security groups associated with a mount target.

methods.name: modifyMountTargetSecurityGroupsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously modifies mount target security groups.

methods.name: putBackupPolicy
methods.description: Creates or updates a backup policy.

methods.name: putBackupPolicyAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates or updates a backup policy.

methods.name: putFileSystemPolicy
methods.description: Applies a policy to a file system.

methods.name: putFileSystemPolicyAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously applies a policy to a file system.

methods.name: updateFileSystemProtectionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously modifies file system protection settings.
